chunks: We have not sent an apostle before you without instructing him that there is no god but I, so worship Me.

key_terms.لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنَا: there is no god but I

ai.seo_question: What is the common message sent to all prophets according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the continuity of the prophetic mission, affirming that Tawhid was the universal core message revealed to all messengers, from Adam to Muhammad (peace be upon them). It highlights the consistency of divine guidance, where each prophet served as a witness to the oneness of God, reinforcing the Shia belief in the unity of the prophetic chain and the centrality of worship directed solely to Allah.
